text:
Harper: Kickoff — we need a one-page field brief + short webinar (20m) that focuses on hybrid deployment patterns (Hosted + Dedicated + Private) and a tight benchmark narrative for engineers. Sketch in Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/hybrid-brief-v1

Mina: Love the scope. For the one-pager let's do: hero outcome (1 line), security & compliance callouts, micro-benchmark box, routing playbook + CTA. Keep it one printable page for AE email attachments.

Jules: Bench owner here. Recent run (2026-04-05): text-gen-2 @512 tokens on Dedicated p95 = 69ms, median cost per 1k tokens = $0.43. Controlled self-host sample (customer fleet) avg = $0.74/k. Claim: ~42% lower unit cost vs typical self-host. Methodology note: 10k requests steady-state, mixed prompt lengths, cold-start excluded. I'll upload CSV and test notes.

Connor: For the webinar demo, propose a short scripted outage to show automated routing: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private, plus model-variant fallback when quantized variants are used. Proposed date Apr 25 09:00 PT. Mina, can you lead copy? Jules, you'll present bench slide?

Mina: Yes. I'll draft the landing copy and a 30s social post. New headline ideas (for A/B): Variant X = "Hybrid inference: SLA-first, cost-aware" vs Variant Y = "Run LLMs where you need them: Hosted, Dedicated, Private". We should test for registration rate.

Jules: Adding a short methodological footnote in the brief: p95 measured across 99th-run samples with synthetic and customer-shaped prompts; cost = cloud GPU usage + orchestration overhead. Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/hybrid-bench

Harper: Field wants a small routing snippet they can paste into playbooks. Connor, can you provide a minimal example?

Connor: Pasteable inbound routing example for playbook:

```
# simple inbound routing example
if customer.region == 'NA' and customer.data_sensitivity == 'low':
    route_to = 'hosted-api'
elif customer.commitment_monthly >= 30000 or customer.latency_sla == 'strict':
    route_to = 'dedicated-pool'
elif customer.requires_isolation or customer.data_residency == 'on-prem':
    route_to = 'private-deploy'
else:
    route_to = 'hosted-api'
```

Harper: Great. Also add a one-line ops callout about observability: "Token-level cost breakdown and per-route p95 charts available in Console". Field loves that.

Mina: I'll prepare the gated download form fields: company, role, compliance needs, expected QPS, preferred deployment mode. Add a short nurture flow (3 emails): 1) security deep-dive, 2) benchmark + cost models, 3) replay + customer story.

Jules: Uploading the CSV and bench notes now. Also including a tiny graph export for the one-pager (p95 latency bars).

QueueBot: Landing template created at https://redwood.app/landing/hybrid-inference. I can schedule announcement for Apr 25 09:00 PT if assets are final by Apr 21 EOD.

Harper: Assignments: Harper = layout + final PDF; Mina = landing copy + social + gated form + nurture sequence; Jules = bench slides + CSV + graph exports; Connor = demo infra + routing snippet; QueueBot = landing + schedule. Will post PDF draft here for a quick pass by Apr 21. Thanks! :rocket:
